description: NaMoO₃F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded to three O and three equivalent F atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₃F₃ octahedra. There is one shorter (2.41 Å) and two longer (2.55 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.39 Å. The Mo-F bond length is 2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Mo atoms. F is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Mo tetrahedra.
